title: What's streaming this week
canadaNote: In Canada, HBO Max and Peacock titles usually stream on Crave, and Hulu originals usually go to Disney+. Where a Canadian release isn't confirmed, we say so.

outToday.title: Madden
outToday.availability: U.S. and Canada. Prime Video Canada lists it for Nov. 18. It had a short theatrical run first.
outToday.summary: Nicolas Cage plays John Madden in David O. Russell's film about his Super Bowl-winning partnership with Raiders owner Al Davis (Christian Bale), his broadcasting career and the Madden NFL video game.

outToday.title: Guarding Stars
outToday.availability: Netflix original; Netflix originals normally launch worldwide, including Canada.
outToday.summary: A no-nonsense bodyguard (Leighton Meester) poses as the girlfriend of an action star (Jared Padalecki) to protect him over the holidays. Andie MacDowell co-stars; based on Katherine Center's novel The Bodyguard.

outToday.title: Gordon
outToday.availability: Netflix original (Argentina); normally a worldwide launch.
outToday.summary: Director Pablo Trapero's 1970s crime drama starring Rodrigo de la Serna (Money Heist) as the real-life figure Aníbal Gordon.

outToday.title: Win the Mall
outToday.availability: Netflix original; normally a worldwide launch.
outToday.summary: Players move into a working mall and try to outshop and outsmart each other.

outToday.title: Gentle Monster
outToday.availability: Listed by What's on Netflix for the U.S.; Canada not confirmed.
outToday.summary: Léa Seydoux plays a concert pianist whose new life in the countryside unravels when she learns her husband's dark secret. An Austrian psychological drama.

outToday.title: The Rings of Power, Season 3 (two new episodes)
outToday.summary: Galadriel catches up with a lost love, and Sauron catches up to her, according to TVLine's episode guide.

outToday.title: NHL: Canadiens vs. Devils (Wednesday Night Hockey)
outToday.availability: Canada. 7 p.m. ET (5 p.m. B.C. time), per Prime Video Canada.
outToday.summary: Prime Video's Canadian NHL package continues with Montreal against New Jersey.

recent.title: Valentina and the 12 Signs
recent.availability: Netflix original (Brazil); normally a worldwide launch.
recent.summary: A heartbroken woman decides to date one man from every sign of the zodiac.

recent.title: The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County
recent.availability: U.S. Canadian release not confirmed; Hulu originals usually go to Disney+ in Canada.
recent.summary: A spinoff of Hulu's Secret Lives of Mormon Wives, set among a new circle of young women in Orange County. All eight episodes are out.
